answer.text: Existing shareholders (often promoters) selling their holdings through exchange mechanism

explanation.text: The Logic: OFS is a sale of existing shares, typically by promoters, via exchange mechanism. The Trap: New shares are IPOs/FPOs. Cross-Exam Context: Same in XII, IX. Distributor's Pro-Tip: OFS often widens non-promoter holding — track post-OFS shareholding changes.
